result.instructions: Tools for Climatools, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the company called Jansen Installatie and show its address."; "List the installations registered for this company."; "Which relations have an email address on file for Rotterdam?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Climatools data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run climatools_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run climatools_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run climatools_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. climatools_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: climatools_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List business customers (companies) in Climatools, with their addresses and tags. Filter by name or client number. Climatools API: GET /api/companies.

name.description: Only companies whose name matches this value.

client_number.description: Only companies with this client number.

page.description: Page number (default 1). List results are paged.

tools.name: climatools_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company by id. Climatools API: GET /api/companies/{id}.

company_id.description: The id as returned by the matching list tool.

tools.name: climatools_list_relations
tools.title: List relations
tools.description: List private contacts (relations) in Climatools, with addresses and tags. Filter by first name, last name, email or client number. Climatools API: GET /api/relations.

first_name.description: Only relations with this first name.

last_name.description: Only relations with this last name.

email.description: Only relations with this email address.

client_number.description: Only relations with this client number.

page.description: Page number (default 1). List results are paged.

tools.name: climatools_get_relation
tools.title: Get a relation
tools.description: Get one relation (private contact) by id. Climatools API: GET /api/relations/{id}.

relation_id.description: The id as returned by the matching list tool.

tools.name: climatools_list_installations
tools.title: List installations
tools.description: List cooling, gas and other installations in Climatools, with brand, model and refrigerant circuits. Climatools API: GET /api/installations.

page.description: Page number (default 1). List results are paged.

tools.name: climatools_list_refrigerants
tools.title: List refrigerants
tools.description: List the refrigerants Climatools knows (for installation records). Climatools API: GET /api/refrigerants.

page.description: Page number (default 1). List results are paged.

tools.name: climatools_create_company
tools.title: Create a company
tools.description: Create a company (business customer) in Climatools. Name and address are required. Creates a new record each call; check with climatools_list_companies first to avoid duplicates. Climatools API: POST /api/companies.

address.description: The address. Use the object shape from the Climatools API docs (Settings > API), or a single string.

tools.name: climatools_create_relation
tools.title: Create a relation
tools.description: Create a private contact (relation) in Climatools. Last name and address are required. Creates a new record each call; check with climatools_list_relations first to avoid duplicates. Climatools API: POST /api/relations.

last_name.description: The last name (required). Sent as lastName.

address.description: The address. Use the object shape from the Climatools API docs (Settings > API), or a single string.
